review_evidence: README identifies formalized auction theory, Myerson-style mechanism design, von Neumann minimax, Nash equilibrium, and Brouwer fixed-point work.
Zerosum.lean, Matching.lean, Sperner.lean, and GameTheory/ExtensiveForm modules contain reusable structures, definitions, and theorem proofs.
Formal content is distributed across root and GameTheory trees, so duplicate-looking layout cannot be excluded without stronger semantic equivalence evidence.
summary: Retain gametheory: the Lean project contains formal auction theory, zero-sum minimax, Nash/Brouwer work, matching, extensive-form games, and supporting simplex/Sperner theory.
